🌊 Big congrats to CWiW members Raphaela Betz and Saskia Nowicki from University of Oxford on their new publication in ACSES&T Water: 
📄 "Intermittent Contamination of Small Water Supplies: Implications for Effective Monitoring and JMP Global Assessment" 

By examining how monitoring approaches capture (or miss) intermittent contamination, this research helps sharpen the tools used to assess water safety at a global scale — including through the World Health Organization/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP), the mechanism used to track progress on 
hashtag
#SDG 6.

🔗 https://lnkd.in/dxyEGmFq
 
Congratulations to all co-authors! Edith Darin, Jamie Bartram, Katrina Charles.
comment: Intermittent contamination highlights a key field challenge: monitoring frequency and timing can shape the story we tell about water safety. Data design is as important as data collection.
